title: Claude Fable 5.2 against Fable 5.1
summary: Anthropic says Fable 5.2 generates output up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1, at a 20% lower token price. The speed claim holds; the lower price does not reach the cost of a task at max effort, because Fable 5.2 writes far more tokens.

sources.label: Claude Fable 5.1 model page (Intelligence Index v5.0.1)
Claude Fable 5.2 model page (Intelligence Index v5.0.1)

claims.text: Generates output up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1

ref.note: Anthropic's API at max effort. At medium effort the gain is 82 → 109 tokens/s.

claims.text: A 20% lower token price should mean cheaper tasks
claims.scopeNote: Anthropic cut per-token prices by 20%. This checks whether that reaches the cost of a task at max effort.

ref.note: Intelligence Index v5.0.1, both at max effort. Output tokens rose from 163M to 275M.

observations.text: Mythos 5.2 is the same underlying model with fewer safeguards and is available only to vetted organisations, so it has no independent benchmarks of its own.

livePack.note: Starter tasks plus multi-step efficiency tasks.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
